scope.text: Calculus; f continuous over [a,b]; F any antiderivative of f

text: If f is continuous over the interval [a,b] and F(x) is any antiderivative of f(x), then ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) − F(a).
notes: Part 2 (evaluation theorem) of the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus. Source proof in blocks p-79–p-82; reusable proof method recorded as procedure:prove-ftc-part2.
